title: Feature: Clear Ob1G5StateMachine Queue
body:
When using G5/G6, commands to be sent to the sensor are stored in a "commandQueue" to be transmitted and handled on next connection.

Currently, it is not possible to reset/clear this queue.

Example: User entered a calibration in error. While it is possible to undo this calibration on the main screen, it is not possible to remove the calibration request from the command queue - so it is going to be sent to the G5/6 anyway.
Same is true for sensor stop or others. I ran into the problem of wanting to cancel a command to the G5/6 multiple times - but was unable to do so given the current application interface.

If you think, this feature might make sense (even if only running in expert mode), I could try to implement this and make a pull request - I don't currently really have an active insight into the ongoing development @jamorham .

comments.body: @savek-cc That would be a good enhancement. Please can you create a PR?
